issue_context.title: PKCS#7 regression
issue_context.body:
PKCS#7 suffers from problems similar to #12633 and #12684 

e.g.

```
./openssl_wrap.sh openssl smime -sign -in sign.dat -text -out msg -signer cert.pem -inkey seckey.pem -nocerts
STDERR CONTENTS:
Error writing output
00F1E0B3FD7E0000:error::digital envelope routines:evp_generic_fetch:fetch failed:crypto/evp/evp_fetch.c:319:Global default library context, Algorithm (md_gost94), Properties (<null>)
00F1E0B3FD7E0000:error::PKCS7 routines:pkcs7_bio_add_digest:unknown digest type:crypto/pkcs7/pk7_doit.c:76:
```


The openssl_wrap.sh script:
```
#!/bin/bash
  
OPENSSLDIR=`pwd`/../openssl
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$OPENSSLDIR
OPENSSL_CONF=`pwd`/engine.conf $GDB $OPENSSLDIR/apps/openssl $@
```

engine.conf file:
```
openssl_conf = openssl_def
[openssl_def]
engines = engine_section

[engine_section]
gost = gost_section

[gost_section]
engine_id = gost
dynamic_path = /path/to/gost.so
default_algorithms = ALL
CRYPT_PARAMS = id-Gost28147-89-CryptoPro-A-ParamSet

[req]
distinguished_name = req_dn
[ req_dn ]
C = RU
L = Moscow
CN=Test srv gost2012_256:XA
O=Cryptocom
OU=OpenSSL CA
emailAddress = openssl@cryptocom.ru
```
